info.title: Switch Frame Tap
info.author: TomasUribe
info.description: Stream gameplay and audio to a PC without a capture card.
info.details:
Switch Frame Tap is a sysmodule for streaming gameplay and audio to a PC over USB or the network. It uses the H.264 encoder and supports up to 1080p60fps where available.

It supports native-resolution screenshots, recording through the PC viewer, network streaming, and USB webcam mode.

A reboot is required after installation or updating so the sysmodule can restart.

changelog:
v0.7.13.2

A one-file fix on top of v0.7.13.1:

- **Sound in games that block recording, on firmware 23.0 and 23.0.1.** The bundled patches (exelix11's dvr-patches) had no file for firmware 23's system, so "Sound in no-record games" did nothing there (Smash Ultimate, Octopath Traveler had no sound). The 19th patch from dvr-patches' fw-23.0.1 release, which covers both 23.0 and 23.0.1, is now included. Thanks to the reporter of #29 for tracking it down (#28 too).

Nothing else changed: the Switch side is v0.7.13.1 plus this file. The viewers are unchanged.

**Installing:** unzip `switch-frame-tap-0.7.13.2-switch.zip` over the SD card root and reboot (settings are kept). If "Sound in no-record games" is on, the new file is copied in during that first boot and works from the next one, so reboot once more.
